newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian rupee moves up vs dlr as RBI stays away.
newsitem.headline: Indian rupee moves up vs dlr as RBI stays away.

text.p: The Indian rupee moved up against the dollar in Thursday afternoon trade on poor deamnd, dealers said.
They said the rupee moved up to 35.745 after opening at 35.755/765.
"At the moment, there is no demand at all," said a dealer. "The Reserve Bank of India (RBI) has not yet made an appearance."
Dealers said with the rupee moving up and the RBI staying away, some banks will now have to unwind their long dollar positions.
"The rupee can only move up unless RBI intervenes," said a dealer.
In latest deals, the dollar was quoted at 35.745/755 rupees, dealers said.
